note: The result schema P2-I requires. Both documents the harness writes are held to these shapes by the harness itself before it writes them - a report that does not conform is refused with a non-zero exit, not written with a caveat - and tests/Unit/Performance holds the schema and the tool to each other. The type vocabulary is deliberately small: object, array, number, string, boolean. Every measurement document must bind its provenance (commit, engine, seed) because the contract says a result that cannot name what produced it is not a result.
